rows.ja: 供給元(半導体・製造委託)
AIネットワークの提携先(各社のコメント)

relations.text: スイッチ用チップを主にBroadcomに依存(主なマーチャントシリコンの供給元)
relations.text_en: Primarily reliant on Broadcom, its predominant merchant silicon vendor, for switching chips

source.label: ANET 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we are primarily reliant upon our predominant merchant silicon vendor, Broadcom, for our switching chips

relations.text: BroadcomからVeloCloud事業を3億ドルの現金で取得
relations.text_en: Acquired the VeloCloud business from Broadcom for $300.0M in cash

source.label: ANET 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the VeloCloud business ("VeloCloud") from Broadcom

relations.text: スケールアップ向けのEthernet標準で協業(ESUN、Broadcomのコメント)
relations.text_en: ESUN collaboration on standards-based scale-up Ethernet (Broadcom’s comment)

source.label: Arista のソリューションページ(各社のコメント、2026年10月)
source.quote: Through our ESUN collaboration with Arista, we are bringing standards-based, low-latency scale-up connectivity to market
source.note: 各社のコメントで、取引条件は示されていません。
source.note_en: A partner comment; no commercial terms are stated.

relations.text: Jabilは主な製造委託先だ
relations.text_en: Jabil is a primary contract manufacturing partner

source.label: ANET 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary manufacturing partners are Jabil Inc., Sanmina Corporation and Foxconn Hon Hai.

relations.text: Sanminaは、主な製造委託先の一社
relations.text_en: Sanmina is a primary contract manufacturing partner

source.label: ANET 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary manufacturing partners are Jabil Inc., Sanmina Corporation and Foxconn Hon Hai.

relations.text: Hon Hai(Foxconn)は主な製造委託先を務める
relations.text_en: Hon Hai (Foxconn) is a primary contract manufacturing partner

source.label: ANET 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary manufacturing partners are Jabil Inc., Sanmina Corporation and Foxconn Hon Hai.

relations.text: ArmとAristaがオープンなAIシステムで協力(Armのコメント)
relations.text_en: Arm and Arista are working together on open AI systems (Arm’s comment)

source.label: Arista のソリューションページ(各社のコメント、2026年10月)
source.quote: Arm and Arista are working to advance this vision, enabling more flexible and efficient systems for demanding AI workloads.
source.note: 各社のコメントで、取引条件は示されていません。
source.note_en: A partner comment; no commercial terms are stated.

relations.text: Arista製スイッチとAMDのラック型AI基盤を組み合わせる提携を拡大(AMDのコメント)
relations.text_en: Extends its partnership with Arista on open rack-scale architectures (AMD’s comment)

source.label: Arista のソリューションページ(各社のコメント、2026年10月)
source.quote: By extending our deep partnership with Arista to open rack-scale architectures that combine Arista's switching platforms with our AMD Pensando Vulcano 800 AI NICs
source.note: 各社のコメントで、取引条件は示されていません。
source.note_en: A partner comment; no commercial terms are stated.

relations.text: Metaの102.4Tスケールアウト基盤向けのラックネットワークで協業(Metaのコメント)
relations.text_en: Collaborates with Arista on rack-scale networking for its 102.4T scale-out platforms (Meta’s comment)

source.label: Arista のソリューションページ(各社のコメント、2026年10月)
source.quote: Meta is pleased to collaborate with Arista on rack-scale networking solutions for our 102.4T scale-out platforms.
source.note: 各社のコメントで、取引条件は示されていません。
source.note_en: A partner comment; no commercial terms are stated.

relations.text: Maia AIアクセラレーター向けのスケールアップ構成の設計で提携を拡大(Microsoftのコメント)
relations.text_en: Extends its partnership with Arista to design a scale-up solution for Maia accelerators (Microsoft’s comment)

source.label: Arista のソリューションページ(各社のコメント、2026年10月)
source.quote: We are extending our partnership with Arista to design a high-performance, high-bandwidth scale-up solution for our Maia AI accelerators.
source.note: 各社のコメントで、取引条件は示されていません。
source.note_en: A partner comment; no commercial terms are stated.

relations.text: Ciscoは、Aristaのデータセンター・キャンパス向けネットワークの競合に当たる
relations.text_en: Cisco competes with Arista in data center and campus networking

source.label: ANET 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: with competition also coming from other large network equipment and system vendors, including Dell/EMC, Extreme Networks, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Huawei, Juniper Networks, Nvidia

relations.text: Ciscoの競合には、Aristaも含まれる
relations.text_en: Arista is among Cisco's competitors

source.label: Cisco 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our competitors (in each case relative to only some of our products or services) include: Amazon Web Services LLC; Arista Networks, Inc.

source.quote: with competition also coming from other large network equipment and system vendors, including Dell/EMC, Extreme Networks, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Huawei, Juniper Networks, Nvidia

relations.text_en: Extreme competes with Arista to a lesser extent

source.quote: To a lesser extent, Extreme competes with products and solutions from Arista Networks

companies.name: Hewlett Packard Enterprise
companies.sub: サーバー・ネットワーク

source.label: ANET 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: with competition also coming from other large network equipment and system vendors, including Dell/EMC, Extreme Networks, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Huawei, Juniper Networks, Nvidia

source.quote: Our primary competitors are technology vendors, such as Cisco Systems, Inc., Arista Networks Inc

companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.sub: AI半導体・ネットワーク

source.label: ANET 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: with competition also coming from other large network equipment and system vendors, including Dell/EMC, Extreme Networks, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Huawei, Juniper Networks, Nvidia

source.label: NVIDIA 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: networking products consisting of switches, network adapters (including DPUs), and cable solutions (including optical modules) include such as AMD, Arista Networks, Broadcom

source.quote: Arista DANZ Monitoring Fabric ("DMF") competes with Cisco, Gigamon, Keysight, Netscout

relations.text: Celesticaは、データセンター向けスイッチ分野でOEMのAristaと競合している
relations.text_en: Celestica competes with OEMs including Arista in data center switching

source.label: Celestica 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we also face competition from OEMs (including Arista Networks, Inc., Cisco Systems, Inc. and others)

relations.text: Qualcomm幹部が、大規模なアクセラレーター導入向けのAristaのネットワーク製品を歓迎するコメント
relations.text_en: A Qualcomm Technologies executive welcomed Arista networking solutions for large-scale accelerator deployments
